corrections.title: UK Visas and Immigration: Pay for UK healthcare as part of your immigration application
corrections.quote: £1,035 per year for all other visa and immigration applications, for example £3,105 for a 3-year visa
corrections.summary: The UK Home Office explains that the healthcare surcharge is £1,035 per year for all other visa and immigration applications, for example £3,105 for a 3-year visa. The rate is £776 per year for students, their dependants, and those on a Youth Mobility Scheme visa. You do not need to pay the surcharge if you are applying from outside the UK for 6 months or less. This record summarizes published fees; it does not assess individual visa eligibility.
